command: node dev/bump-check.js berserker-test-claude --js "raw.classes[0].levels=6; raw.classes[0].hitPoints.push(7); raw.classes[0].archetype={name:'Armored Approach'}; raw.featureNotes={'environmental shielding':'cold'}"   (and: node dev/bump-check.js armstech-test-local --js "raw.classes[0].archetype={name:'Construction Engineering'}; delete raw.classes[0].options")
expected: Environmental Shielding: resistance to cold only, while wearing the spiked armor. Elemental Shielding: only the matching amplifier types. Build and Destroy: nothing for the engineer (the resistance is the structures')
actual: 'Resistances: Resistance to damage' (every type; the chosen type is ignored) for both Shieldings. 'Resistances: Resistance to kinetic, energy, and ion damage' on the engineer for Build and Destroy
rule: "Choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or sonic. While wearing your spiked armor, you have resistance to damage of the chosen type." / "...your portable structures have resistance to kinetic, energy, and ion damage dealt by weapons."
code: app/classes.js clsFeatureEffects: the 'resistance to ([^.]*?damage...)' reader takes 'resistance to damage' literally and doesn't check who has the resistance

title: Way of Endurance: Upheld by the Force adds neither hit points nor AC

code: app/classes.js clsFeatureEffects has no reader for 'hit point maximum increases by' (that reader exists only for species, in featureEffectsUncached) or for 'base AC becomes 13 +'
